rule: A level is recommended for a role only if it meets that role's floor on two consecutive runs AND its p95 latency fits the role's cadence. Defaults stay 'default' whatever the numbers (overview rule 9). Floors are never retuned.

arms.expect: every level except default reads unsupported (F6); run default + one level to prove the refusal, not the full sweep
off = enable_thinking false; low/medium/high collapse to one 'on' arm (F5)

arms.model: <pick one reasoning-capable model and write it here BEFORE the first call (overview W23)>

read.floor: plotDeltaAccuracy >= 0.9 and the default per-tier floors (facts=0.85,rejected=0.9,epistemic=0.8,ledger=0.8,arcs=0.8)
read.latency: p95 <= the read interval at cadence 3 on the reference hardware (measure the interval on the arm's own default run first and write it here)

synthesis.latency: p95 from the report's records[].latencyMs; off-path, bound only by the scene cadence

authoring.floor: v2.4 plan 08 authoring floors; no hold-out since v2.6 W25 removed the all-Spanish one

director.floor: director accuracy over D01-D26 minus D15, 22 of 25 (v2.2 / plan 14 floor as declared in so-role-calibration; D15 went with v2.6 W25)
director.latency: p95 <= 4000 ms (on-path before the group reply; DIRECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS is the hard bound)

verdict: node scripts/debug/so-role-calibration.mts verdict <r1.json> <r2.json> per role x arm x level; for read, both live-suite reports must be ok:true
hypothesis: read/director best at off; authoring/synthesis gain at medium. To test, not to assume.
output: docs/plans/v2.6/recommended-reasoning.md (one row per role x arm; the UI line comes from it)
records: test/measurements/v2.6-05/<arm>/<role>-<level>-r<n>.json (copy each report out of the debug dir in the same commit as the table)
